waterloo.name: Lion's Mound
waterloo.slogan: A hill of battlefield earth, with a bronze lion on top.
waterloo.line: Waterloo is a battle of the first rank won by a captain of the second.

namur.name: Namur Citadel
namur.slogan: A thousand years of walls above the Sambre and the Meuse.
namur.line: The citadel's present form was designed by Menno van Coehoorn, and Vauban improved it after the 1692 siege.

bouillon.name: Bouillon Castle
bouillon.slogan: Godfrey's rock, wrapped in a bend of the Semois.
bouillon.line: In 1082 Godfrey of Bouillon inherited the castle, later selling it to the Bishop of Liège to fund the First Crusade.

dinantcitadel.name: Dinant Citadel
dinantcitadel.slogan: Climb above the Meuse and the pointed church tower.
dinantcitadel.line: The site was first fortified in 1051; the present fortress dates from 1815.

namoignies.name: Treasure of Oignies
namoignies.slogan: Medieval gold and silver, signed by a lay brother.
namoignies.line: Hugo d'Oignies signed several of his works, rare for medieval silverware, and the treasure was hidden during the French Revolution.
